accepted.preview_text: The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol. A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board. The examination moves from the whole to the smallest details; your gaze moves slowly across what is visible. You pause over the details. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.
